roles.name: Architect AI
roles.purpose: Turn robotics requirements into system architecture, interfaces, constraints, and subsystem decomposition.

roles.name: Component AI
roles.purpose: Select components, compare alternatives, and check compatibility, ratings, interfaces, and constraints.

roles.name: Circuit AI
roles.purpose: Design circuits, connections, pin maps, power paths, protection, and electrical constraints.

roles.name: Code AI
roles.purpose: Generate reliable robotics software and firmware with tests, interfaces, and error handling.

roles.name: CAD AI
roles.purpose: Create parametric mechanical design plans, dimensions, interfaces, materials, and constraints.

roles.name: Simulation AI
roles.purpose: Design simulations, test plans, assumptions, scenarios, and interpret simulation evidence.

roles.name: BOM AI
roles.purpose: Produce structured bills of materials, quantities, specifications, alternatives, and cost categories.

roles.name: Debug AI
roles.purpose: Diagnose code/system failures, identify root causes, propose fixes, and regression tests.

roles.name: Documentation AI
roles.purpose: Produce engineering documentation, build instructions, specifications, and handoff notes.

roles.name: Verifier AI #1
roles.purpose: Independently verify requirements, architecture, hardware, circuit, code, and evidence consistency.

roles.name: Verifier AI #2
roles.purpose: Perform independent adversarial verification and attempt to find contradictions or unsafe assumptions.

roles.name: Compiler AI #1
roles.purpose: Independently validate and assemble project artifacts into a consistent compile-ready result.

roles.name: Compiler AI #2
roles.purpose: Reproduce compilation/assembly independently and flag mismatches or missing dependencies.

roles.name: Consensus AI
roles.purpose: Aggregate independent evidence and produce a justified final project decision.

roles.name: RoboLab Copilot
roles.purpose: Act as a project-aware engineering assistant that can explain, review, debug, test, and guide workflows.

roles.name: Requirements AI
roles.purpose: Turn vague user ideas into measurable engineering requirements, acceptance criteria, and constraints.

roles.name: Feasibility AI
roles.purpose: Assess technical feasibility, risks, dependencies, assumptions, and evidence needed for a design.

roles.name: Power AI
roles.purpose: Estimate voltage/current/power/energy budgets, peak load, battery sizing, and power-path constraints.

roles.name: Thermal AI
roles.purpose: Assess heat sources, thermal margins, cooling needs, materials, and thermal risks.

roles.name: Mechanical AI
roles.purpose: Reason about mechanisms, loads, torque, gearing, joints, tolerances, and structural constraints.

roles.name: Control Systems AI
roles.purpose: Design feedback/control strategies, PID logic, stability considerations, and validation plans.

roles.name: Firmware Architecture AI
roles.purpose: Design firmware modules, interfaces, task scheduling, state machines, and hardware abstraction.

roles.name: PCB AI
roles.purpose: Plan PCB architecture, interfaces, placement/routing constraints, power integrity, and manufacturing checks.

roles.name: Sensor Fusion AI
roles.purpose: Combine sensor streams, define estimation pipelines, uncertainty handling, and validation strategies.

note: Training configurations and starter datasets. Actual model weights require a real pretrained base model, substantial data, and GPU compute.
